# Alex Zalesov (Alex Zall) — Full Profile

> Senior AI/Cloud Engineer and technical consultant. 15+ years experience.
> Available for consulting, fractional CTO, and senior engineering engagements.

## About
Alex Zalesov (also known as Alex Zall) is a senior software engineer and technical leader
specialising in AI-first product development, LLM systems, agentic workflows, and cloud-native
architecture. He has led engineering teams and held principal/CTO-level roles at both startups
and scale-ups across Europe. Based in Malaga, Spain. Available remote.

## Services
- AI-first development: custom LLM integration, agent pipelines, RAG systems
- Agentic systems: multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph, LangChain, VertexAI
- Cloud infrastructure: GCP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, autoscaling
- SaaS ownership: full product lifecycle from MVP to production
- Technical leadership: engineering team scaling, technical strategy, fractional CTO
- Architecture: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven, real-time systems

## Work History

### Mult.dev — Chief Everything Officer (Aug 2024–present)
AI-powered video generation platform. GCP-based autoscaling GPU cluster reducing processing
costs by ~40%. TypeScript + Python stack.

### Peec.ai — Principal AI Engineer (Jan 2025–Aug 2025)
AI influencer analytics platform. Berlin.

### Beeboard — Head of Engineering (Dec 2023–present)
SaaS project management (Lean/PEP methodology). Berlin.

### Quickcommerce / Orcrist (Zapp) — Senior Engineer (Sep 2021–Sep 2023)
Quick-commerce delivery platform. Full stack from consumer app to ops infrastructure.
ML model predicting delivery time across 40+ parameters. Berlin/London.

### MOIA / Volkswagen — Senior Engineer (2019–2021)
On-demand ride-hailing. Real-time simulation service using live demand data. Berlin.

### Zalando — Senior Engineer (2017–2018)
AI image labelling for fashion e-commerce. Berlin.

### SoundCloud — Senior Engineer (2013–2017)
Built the canonical SoundCloud audio player on the web. Scala/functional programming. Berlin.
